artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical, characteristic of AI generation failing to render coherent typography. While some real photos might have blurry text, this has the specific 'alien script' look of generative artifacts.
The texture is uniformly noisy and slightly 'mushy' rather than having sharp, distinct leather grains or plastic reflections. It lacks the micro-detail of a real photograph.

The top edges of the binders, particularly the one behind the main subject, appear slightly warped and inconsistent in straightness, lacking the rigid geometric precision expected of cardboard/plastic binders.
